Trans Canada Bike Route (BC Only)

A ride mapped and described by Trans Canada Bike Route Network

7,361 cycling stops along this route · Thompson Okanagan

5446 km · ExpeditionEpicRide with trafficMostly pavedRemote stretches

The British Columbia portion of the proposed Trans Canada Bike Route, a national coast-to-coast cycling network still taking shape. The BC section maps about 5,400 km of connected riding, nearly all on paved roads, reaching from Vancouver Island through the southern Interior to the Cariboo. A planning framework and a dream to follow rather than a signed trail: expect ordinary highway conditions.

The route lives with its publisher
The full map, turn-by-turns, GPX, and the story behind this ride are on Trans Canada Bike Route Network.

This page covers what surrounds the route: welcoming stops, the communities along the way, and how to reach it.
